svg.title: Your researcher and the Lab: one skill per step
svg.desc: Your researcher unites the Investment Lab pipeline, with one skill per step of its eight: 1 Bibliotheca, read, objective and blueprint; 2 Universe, universe; 3 Data, curator and analyzer; 4 Portfolio, portfolio; 5 Backtest, backtest; 6 Attribution, attribution and alpha; 7 Paper trading, the graduation gate; 8 Production, outside the Lab. You ask which step you are on; your researcher answers: step 5, the backtest, with a plan to run the Backtest Engine with its skill, for your approval. init-example copies the full Golden-Flow to study; init-strategy starts yours, with the same folders. It knows which step you are on, what comes next and which library to use; it plans and asks before writing; the numbers come only from the Lab.
